# Markbase

> The AI-native markdown humans and agents write together. Markbase is a shared workspace where people and the AI agents they already use (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and more over MCP) read, write, comment on, and publish the same living markdown documents — one versioned source of truth for both.

Markbase treats an agent as a first-class collaborator on the document itself, not a chat box on the side. Agents make precise quote-and-replace edits to the passage you name (structure preserved, not regenerated), leave comments anchored to exact text, and resolve them once settled — while humans keep authority over the content. Everything is plain markdown with full version history and one-click rollback, per-person and per-agent access roles (owner, editor, commenter, viewer), and any document can be published as a clean, server-rendered public page built for search engines and AI answers.

## Docs
- [Overview](https://markbase.so/p/overview-5ac13a99): What Markbase is, how it works (the doc, the collaborators, the reach), and what makes it AI-native.
- [Quick start](https://markbase.so/p/overview-5ac13a99): Connect Claude Code and Claude Desktop over MCP in under a minute with `npx @markbase/cli@latest mcp install`.
- [Welcome](https://markbase.so/p/welcome-to-jessie-docs-74cd8aaa): Example published Markbase document.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://markbase.so): Product overview, features, and how it works.
- [See a live document](https://markbase.so/p/overview-5ac13a99): A real Markbase page, published from a document.

## Key facts
- Name: Markbase
- Category: AI-native collaborative markdown documentation / knowledge base
- Website: https://markbase.so
- Agent integration: MCP (Model Context Protocol); works today with Claude Code and Claude Desktop; Cursor, Codex, opencode, Pi, and OpenClaw noted as upcoming.
- Core capabilities: real-time human+agent co-editing of markdown, quote-and-replace precise edits, inline anchored comments, full version history with rollback, granular per-person/per-agent roles, one-click publish to SEO- and GEO-ready pages, developer ticketing add-on.
- Differentiator: the agent edits and comments on the same document as the team — one source of truth — instead of context being pasted between chats and tools.
